title: 第19章 三宗上门第20章 星河师兄又立功了
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 药王宫，大长老给楚星河制定了每日的禁闭计划。
上午修炼昊天战意以及熟悉昊天剑匣，药王宫上下一群长老轮流来给楚星河喂招，虽然痛苦，但战斗力是肉眼可见的突飞猛进。
只不过昊天剑匣目前为止楚星河发现自己依旧只能使用一把飞蝗，后面的其他神剑还无法使用，应该是修为还没有达到。
下午是痛苦的，大长老亲自传授楚星河炼药之法，虽有药圣传承，但传承想要消化还是需要指导的，大长老的指导方式非常简单粗暴，那就是练！
玩儿了命的炼药！
事实证明大长老的手段是真的有效的。
当楚星河第一次炼制出四品丹药，极品的血灵丹之时，大长老总算是露出了笑容，与此同时楚星河也的确掌握了一些精髓，此后再去炼制血灵丹的时候，只要不分神，竟然大部分时候都能直接炼制出极品来。
“这才是药圣传承该有的样子！”
大长老看着楚星河产出的极品丹药笑眯眯。
不过药王宫难受的可不是只有楚星河一人，冯飞这些天也是难受至极。
三百万株申灵草的事情虽然没有人怪他，但冯飞还是觉得很内疚，所以这些天他一直在思索着到底要怎么处理这三百万株申灵草呢？
昊天宗也有自己的商队，冯飞也去找过昊天宗的商队，但人家听说要卖出去三百万株申灵草的时候，商队管事差点吓尿了！
毫不夸张的说，申灵草这玩意儿，外界需求量那就跟没有似的。
别说三百万了，一年卖出去三万株那都得连坑带骗的才能做到。
所以这三百万株申灵草这会儿除了压在药王宫新建的药材库里之外，根本没有任何的用处。
冯飞也找大长老谈了，对此大长老的意思是让冯飞自己处理。
冯飞一咬牙一跺脚，真不行……咱就降价卖吧，虽然亏一点，但至少还能处理掉不是。
冯飞这边因为申灵草的事情头疼无比。
这一日，大长老正在指导楚星河炼药，门外有弟子进来，大长老抬头看向进门的弟子，是沈春。
“大长老，星月宗的马长老、东月阁的上官长老还有北冥城的徐长老一起来了……”
“什么？”
大长老听到这三家愣了一下。
天下十大宗派，昊天宗稳坐榜首，但在昊天宗之下还有九个极为强盛的宗派，这三家正在其中。
虽说平日里十大宗派之间虽然也有所走动，可是三家的长老一起出现在昊天宗，那还真是头一遭。
大长老知道，如果不是有什么要事，他们绝不可能出现。
看了一眼休息的楚星河，大长老开口：“别趴着装死了，跟我去见见这三家的长老，另外沈春你通知冯飞先去招待三位贵客，我随后就到。”
沈春领命而去，楚星河也是快速爬了起来。
只要不让咱炼药，干啥都行！
三家长老一起来，大长老也不敢怠慢，换上了他那一身紫金色雷纹袍，这是代表大长老身份的服饰。
楚星河也换上了自己的亲传弟子服，黑色的弟子服之上金边镶嵌，云纹遍布，而除此之外，亲传弟子的衣服还会有一些星纹点缀，看起来也是华贵无比。
跟着大长老来到药王宫最大的贵宾室，一进门就看到三个老家伙正指着新建的药王宫啧啧称赞。
“三位长老久等了，老夫失礼了。”
content_en:
In Medicine King Palace, the great elder made a daily confinement plan for Chu Xinghe.
In the morning, after practicing Haotian's fighting spirit and familiarizing themselves with the Haotian Sword Box, a group of elders from Yaowang Palace took turns feeding Chu Xinghe with moves. Although it was painful, his combat effectiveness was improving by leaps and bounds visible to the naked eye.
However, so far in the Haotian Sword Box, Chu Xinghe found that he could only use one locust, and the other divine swords behind him could not be used. It should be because his cultivation level had not been reached yet.
The afternoon was painful. The great elder personally taught Chu Xinghe the method of refining medicine. Although there is a medicine sage inheritance, the inheritance still needs guidance to digest. The great elder's guidance method is very simple and crude, that is, practice!
A life-threatening elixir!
Facts have proved that the great elder's method is really effective.
When Chu Xinghe refined the fourth-grade elixir, the top-grade Blood Spirit Pill, for the first time, the Great Elder finally showed a smile. At the same time, Chu Xinghe did master some of the essence. When he refined the Blood Spirit Pill again, as long as he was not distracted, most of the time he could directly refine the top-grade Blood Spirit Pill.
"This is what the Medicine Saint inheritance should be like!"
The Great Elder smiled as he looked at the top-grade elixir produced by Chu Xinghe.
However, Chu Xinghe is not the only one who feels uncomfortable in Yaowang Palace. Feng Fei is also feeling extremely uncomfortable these days.
Although no one blamed him for the three million Shenling grass, Feng Fei still felt very guilty, so these days he has been thinking about what to do with these three million Shenling grass?
The Haotian Sect also has its own caravan, and Feng Fei also went to find the Haotian Sect's caravan, but when he heard that three million Shenling Grasses were going to be sold, the caravan manager was almost scared to death!
It is no exaggeration to say that there is no external demand for Shen Ling Cao.
Not to mention three million, to sell 30,000 plants a year would have to involve cheating.
Therefore, these three million Shen Ling Cao are of no use at all except being placed in the newly built medicinal material warehouse of the Medicine King Palace.
Feng Fei also talked to the great elder, but the great elder wanted Feng Fei to handle it himself.
Feng Fei gritted his teeth and stamped his feet, "I can't do it... let's sell it at a lower price. Although it will cost a little, at least it can be disposed of."
Feng Fei was having a huge headache because of the Shen Lingcao matter.
On this day, the great elder was instructing Chu Xinghe in refining medicine. A disciple came in from outside the door. The great elder raised his head and looked at the disciple who came in. It was Shen Chun.
"The Great Elder, Elder Ma from Xingyue Sect, Elder Shangguan from Dongyue Pavilion, and Elder Xu from Beiming City are here..."
"What?"
The elder was stunned for a moment when he heard these three families.
Among the top ten sects in the world, the Haotian Sect is firmly at the top of the list, but there are nine extremely powerful sects under the Haotian Sect, and these three are among them.
Although there was some movement among the ten major sects on weekdays, it was the first time that the elders of the three sects appeared together in Haotian Sect.
The great elder knew that if there was no important matter, they would never show up.
After taking a look at Chu Xinghe who was resting, the elder said: "Don't lie down and pretend to be dead. Come with me to meet the elders of these three families. In addition, Shen Chun, please inform Feng Fei to entertain the three distinguished guests first. I will arrive soon."
Shen Chun took the order and left, and Chu Xinghe quickly got up.
As long as we are not allowed to refine medicine, we can do anything!
The three elders came together, and the eldest elder did not dare to neglect. He put on his purple and gold thunder pattern robe, which was the attire that represented the identity of the eldest elder.
Chu Xinghe also put on his direct disciple uniform. The black disciple uniform was inlaid with gold and covered with cloud patterns. In addition, the direct disciple's clothes were also embellished with some star patterns, which looked extremely luxurious.
I followed the great elder to the largest VIP room of Yaowang Palace. As soon as I entered the door, I saw three old guys pointing at the newly built Yaowang Palace and praising it.
"The three elders have been waiting for a long time. I'm sorry."
title_en: Chapter 19 Three sects come to visit Chapter 20 Senior brother Xinghe has made meritorious deeds again
